about: Version 2 alarm records (EclipseTracker 2.1.0): an alarm set while a city is chosen counts from the minute the eclipse starts at the city, in the city's zone, wherever the phone is. Made by tools/vectors/build-vectors.py with Python's zoneinfo as the oracle. cases: for 16 cities, the first 10 eclipses seen after 2026-11-12 and 9 alarm options plus one edge wall time each. plan is when it rings (the same for every phone zone) and fates is what a re-plan does one hour before, at, and one hour after that instant, with the phone in the zone given. hand: clock-change days and records that must be refused. defaults: the alarm a new planner starts with, and the instant it rings. widestStartOffsetMinutes is the largest distance of a start from greatest eclipse in these cases. Instants are UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.
